summaryZh: Perry 实验室研究基因组如何编码神经系统复杂性，以昆虫视觉系统的自然种间差异为切入点。团队利用果蝇遗传与成像工具，并研究蝴蝶、蚊子和家蝇，寻找改变视觉系统的特定遗传变化。
researchQuestions: 基因组如何编码脑与神经系统的复杂性？

evidence.quote: In order to understand the links that connect the genome to neural function, my lab focuses on naturally occurring differences between species. We use the insect visual system as a model

Our lab is, at the core, a Drosophila lab, taking full advantage of our extensive knowledge of the fly visual system and the panoply of genetic and imaging tools available there, while focusing on uncovering specific genetic changes that make other species different.
One of the most interesting questions in biology is how the genome encodes the complexity of the brain and nervous system.
